content: Some of the domains where it is more important to be able to perform this kind of action are the juridical and legal ones. Effectively, it is crucial to have the capability to analyse open access text sources, like social nets (Twitter and Facebook, for instance), blogs, online newspapers, and to be able to extract the relevant information and represent it in a knowledge base, allowing posterior inferences and reasoning.
